name: Read a CV
description: Business Ladder, Hiring & People, Level 1 (Assist). One CV per case for a Payroll Officer job: fill in the screening form by written rules (current paid job, months of relevant experience by a stated counting rule with overlaps counted once, highest completed qualification, notice period, and the right-to-work statement exactly as written). Later CVs add the real traps: a degree still in progress, a voluntary role running to "Present", an employer with "Payroll" in its name, payroll duties under another title, overlapping part-time roles, a promotion and a changed notice period noted at the end, candidates whose right to work must never be guessed from their background, and in the hard third part-time months counted at half, internships excluded and the longest unbroken run of relevant work.
hook: One CV, eight boxes. Count the experience properly and never guess what isn’t written.
author: Gauntlet Core

cases.prompt:
We are hiring a Payroll Officer. Read this CV and fill in the screening form using the rules below. Use only what the CV says.

CV:
<<<
HIROSHI MURPHY
Belfast · hiroshi.murphy@example.com · CV updated April 2026

PROFILE
Organised, accurate payroll professional who enjoys getting the detail right.

EXPERIENCE
Payroll Officer — Kestrel Engineering Ltd, Jun 2022 – Present
  • Run the monthly payroll for 380 staff on Sage 200
  • Process starters, leavers and statutory sick pay
Payroll Assistant — Thornbury Retail Group, Sep 2019 – May 2022
  • Checked timesheets and overtime claims
  • Answered payslip queries

EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS
  • BSc (Hons) Accounting and Finance, University of Leeds, 2019
  • A levels: Maths (A), Business (B), Economics (B)

OTHER
  • Notice period: 4 weeks
  • Right to work: I have the right to work in the UK.
  • Full UK driving licence
>>>

Rules:
- current_role and current_employer: their current PAID job (the one running to "Present"). Ignore voluntary roles. If the CV says their job title has since changed, use the new title.
- Relevant roles: paid roles whose JOB TITLE contains "Payroll" or "Pensions" (any capitals), except internships and work experience (a title containing "Intern" or "Work experience"). Duties listed under other job titles, and the employer’s name, do not count. A role is part-time only if its title says "(part-time)". The start month and the end month both count ("Mar 2020 – Jun 2020" is 4 months); "Present" means up to and including the month the CV was updated (April 2026).
- relevant_experience_months: add up the calendar months: a month counts 1 if a full-time relevant role covers it, 0.5 if only part-time relevant roles cover it, and a month covered by several relevant roles still counts once (at the higher value). The answer can end in .5.
- longest_unbroken_relevant_months: the longest run of consecutive calendar months each covered by at least one relevant role (full- or part-time), as a whole number of months.
- highest_qualification: their highest COMPLETED qualification, one of: "GCSE", "A level", "HND or foundation degree", "Bachelor's degree", "Master's degree", "Doctorate". (BSc/BA = bachelor's; MSc/MA/MBA = master's; PhD = doctorate.) A qualification in progress or not completed does not count. Professional diplomas that are not degrees do not count.
- notice_period: their current notice period as written, as {"amount": number, "unit": "weeks" or "months"}; "available immediately" is {"amount": 0, "unit": "weeks"}. If the CV says it has changed, use the new one; if it depends on probation, use the one that applies in the month the CV was updated.
- right_to_work: "yes" if the CV states they can work in the UK without sponsorship (any wording, e.g. "British citizen", "settled status", "no sponsorship required"); "needs sponsorship" if it says they would need a visa sponsor (now or later); "not stated" if it says neither. Never infer it from a name, nationality, languages or where someone studied or worked.

Reply with ONE JSON object (a ```json block is fine):
{"current_role": string, "current_employer": string, "relevant_experience_months": number, "longest_unbroken_relevant_months": number, "highest_qualification": string, "notice_period": {"amount": number, "unit": string}, "right_to_work": string}
Give exactly one value per field: a field holding two values, a range or an "X or Y" answer is marked wrong. Every field is checked separately.
cases.notes: relevant months 80 (naive sum without merging overlaps 80); roles: Payroll Officer Jun 2022-present [relevant]; Payroll Assistant Sep 2019-May 2022 [relevant]
